dossier_meta.catalog_title: Exact Ramsey growth rate dependence on G for link hypergraphs
dossier_meta.statement_text: It would be interesting to determine the exact dependence on $G$ in the bounds $\Omega(1/g) \le \frac{\log r(LG,\, K_n^{(3)})}{n \log n} \le O(s)$, where $G$ is a non-bipartite graph on $s$ vertices with odd girth $g \ge 3$.
dossier_meta.context_text: Theorems 1.3 and 1.4 together show that for a non-bipartite graph $G$ on $s$ vertices with odd girth $g \ge 3$ and $n$ sufficiently large, $\Omega(1/g) \le \log r(LG, K_n^{(3)})/(n\log n) \le O(s)$. The exact asymptotic constant as a function of $G$ (or of $s$ and $g$) remains open.
